tok 1.0 "Power supplier switch-over"

pool company "Power supplier switch-over"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start requested "Switch-over requested"
    task transmit "Transmit customer data"
    task checkcontract "Check the contract details"
    eventgw decide "Customer decision"
    catch confirm "Contract confirmed" message="Confirmation"
    catch withdraw "Contract withdrawn" message="Withdrawal"
    catch wait "7 days passed" timer=P7D
    end withdrawn "Switch withdrawn"
    end billed "Final billing received"
    task receivebill "Receive the final billing"
  lane service "Customer service"
    task receive "Receive the customer data"
    task enter "Enter customer data object into CRM"
    task compare "Compare data with customer data base"
    xor errors "Errors found?"
    task correct "Correct the errors"
    xor exists "Customer exists?"
    task create "Create a new customer object"
    task prepare "Prepare the contract documents"
    task ciscontract "Create CIS contract"
    xor merge1
    task import "Import the meter data"
    end imported "Meter data imported"
    xor merge2
  lane cis "CIS"
    task checkdocs "Check the contract documents"
    xor docsok "Documents generated correctly?"
    task resolve "Analyze and resolve the issues"
    and split1
    task confirmation "Send the confirmation document"
    task sendreq "Send the request to the grid operator"
    and join1
  lane grid "Grid operator"
    task checkreq "Check the switch-over request"
    task comment "Transmit the response comment"
    xor concurrence "Supplier concurrence?"
    task inform "Inform the suppliers and demand conflict resolution"
    task terminate "Terminate the sales agreement with the old supplier"
    end conflict "Conflict handed over"
    task meter "Transmit the meter data"
    and split2
    task compute "Compute the final billing"
    task sendbill "Send the final billing to the old supplier"
    end gridend "Grid operator done"
  lane old "Old supplier"
    task createbill "Create the final billing"
    task sendfinal "Send the final billing to the customer"
    end oldend "Old supplier done"

flow requested -> transmit -> receive -> enter -> compare -> errors
flow errors -> correct "yes"
flow errors -> exists "no"
flow correct -> exists
flow exists -> create "no"
flow exists -> merge2 "yes"
flow create -> merge2
flow merge2 -> prepare
flow prepare -> merge1 -> checkdocs -> docsok
flow docsok -> resolve "no"
flow resolve -> merge1
flow docsok -> split1 "yes"
flow split1 -> confirmation
flow split1 -> sendreq
flow confirmation -> join1
flow sendreq -> join1
flow join1 -> checkreq -> comment -> concurrence
flow concurrence -> inform "yes"
flow inform -> terminate -> conflict
flow concurrence -> ciscontract "no"
flow ciscontract -> checkcontract -> decide
flow decide -> confirm
flow decide -> withdraw
flow decide -> wait
flow withdraw -> withdrawn
flow confirm -> meter
flow wait -> meter
flow meter -> split2
flow split2 -> import -> imported
flow split2 -> compute -> sendbill -> createbill -> sendfinal -> receivebill -> billed
flow sendbill -> gridend
